items.rationale: Physically damaged accessory, so indemnifiable under 2.3.3 and 4.2.4; the half reduction also applies to accessories. Small part value, halved.

Pre-existing, age-related defect excluded under 2.3.10(c); no insured peril caused the failure.
Physical damage not established by the loss investigation (4.2.4, 7.1.10), so it does not count as an affected appliance.

Not a repair cost and not among the exhaustive cost heads in 5.1; falls under 7.1.8(e) as diagnostic and documentation outlay. A near-identical line in an earlier case was not indemnified.

items.rationale: Inspection of a component with no established damage; this is upkeep or checking, not repair (7.1.5, 7.1.8(a), 3.1.5).
